payload.partitioning: Relation meaning: 'exchanges stream state' (worktree paths, branch names, instance locations). Coupling reasons classified: F1-F2-F3 couple through the START transaction (F2's verdict gates F1, F1's tree is F3's root) - reason: temporal, one act; cluster START. F4-F5-F6-F7 couple through the SHIP transaction (F4's merge feeds F5's overlap set and F6's conflict check; F7 cleans what F4 finished) - reason: shared merge-base data; cluster SHIP. F8 reads what START and SHIP write but feeds nothing back - support, cluster SURFACE. F9 and F10 touch no stream state at all - independent singletons, cluster GUARDS. Qualities: basic = F1,F3,F4 (a stream you cannot open or reunify is nothing); additional = F2,F5,F8 (order, honesty, visibility); safety = F6,F7 (never guess, never destroy); support = F9,F10. The clusters are candidate-invariant: every enumerated candidate cuts elements along START/SHIP/SURFACE/GUARDS; what varies is WHERE the root-decision lives (inside START vs a shared spine).
